integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Your API keys are stored on the server and never exposed to the browser. Leave a field empty to keep the current value, or use Clear to remove it.

tmdb.label: TMDB API key
tmdb.hint: Use the API Key (v3), not the Read Access Token.

igdb.label: IGDB credentials
igdb.hint: Client ID and Client Secret come from the same Twitch application.

integrations.requireBothIgdb: Fill in both the IGDB Client ID and Secret, or leave both empty.

help.openHelp: How do I get this key?

tmdb.title: How to get a TMDB API key
tmdb.description: The movie search uses your own TMDB key.
steps: Create a free account at themoviedb.org.
Open Account Settings → API and request an API Key (personal use).
Copy the API Key (not the Read Access Token — we use the api_key v3 auth).

igdb.title: How to get IGDB credentials
igdb.description: The game search uses your own Twitch/IGDB application credentials.
steps: Sign in with a Twitch account at dev.twitch.tv.
Open the Developer Console and register a new application.
Copy the Client ID and generate a Client Secret (shown only once).
